features.name: Echt Parish Church
features.fullDescription: William & Andrew Clerk (?) 1804. Gothick. 4-window rectangle harled with margins, original glazing with fluted centre pilaster, high piend roof. 3-bay west front, centre bay advanced with elliptical window, curved gablet, bellcote. Later session house. Interior: original gallery with coats of arms on doric columns; laird's pew with balustraded top; St. Machar-type ceiling, pulpit, lectern and communion table, Dr. Wm. Kelly 1930. Stainbank bell 1868.

features.name: Churchyard With War Memorial, Echt Parish Church, Echt
features.fullDescription: Churchyard dyke partly rebuilt and extended. No old monuments of note but contains War Memorial, bronze, Wm. Macmillan 1921 (base poor, rockfaced dressings, David Morris, of Estate Office) and monument to Viscount Cowdray (+ 1927) by Dr. William Kelly; Greek Sarcophagus on high base with block pediment and volutes, obelisks surmounted by lions.
